title: Toddler Eating in High Chair, 1961 Kitchen B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black and white snapshot taken in March 1961 depicting a young toddler boy sitting in a high chair in a home kitchen. The child holds a piece of food to his mouth with both hands while gazing off to the side. In the background, a tiled countertop holds a bowl and glass, and a dining table with vinyl covering and built-in benches sits against the wall, capturing intimate post-war American suburban domestic life.
